narrative.intro: United Concordia obligated $371M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. United Concordia received 8 awards so far, with an average award size of $46.4M, and obligations are down 7.9% year over year. United Concordia’s fiscal-year obligations have ranged across prior years: FY21 at $438M, FY22 at $507M, FY23 at $384M, FY24 at $387M, and FY25 at $403M. United Concordia’s FY2026 total represents a fiscal-year-to-date figure rather than a full-year total. United Concordia’s top reported buyer for FY2026 to date is the Department of Defense at $372M. United Concordia’s reported data show concentration of obligations in the current fiscal-year-to-date period, with a small number of large awards driving the reported average award size and total obligations.
